Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

IS: 10994 ( Part 9) -1984 



Indian Standard 



( Reaffirmed 2005 ) 




SPECIFICATION FOR 
CARTRIDGES FOR SHOT GUNS 

PART 9 LEAD SHOTS 



1 . Scope — Covers lead shots for shot gun cartridges. 

2. Material and Manufacture — Mixture of 3 to 4 percent antimony conforming to 15:211-1977 
'Specification for antimony {third revision)' and the remaining lead conforming to 18:27-1977 
'Specification for pig lead {ttiird revision)' shall be melted and drawn into wire and lead shots 
shall be formed rolled and chilled.

IS : 10994 ( Part 1 )-1984 'Specification for cartridges for shot guns : Part 1 General requirements',

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Lead shots act as missiles wnen a shot gun cartridge is fired. 

This Indian Standard ( IS : 10994 ) Is being issued in the following parts. Part 1 covering general 
requirements for shot gun cartridges and subsequent parts covering the individual components: 



Part 1 


General requirements 


Part 2 


Blank cartridges 


Part 3 


Case empty 


Part 4 


Cap filled 


Part 5 


Anvil 


Part 6 


Propelfant 


Part 7 


Discs 


Part 8 


Air cushion 


Part 9 


Lead shots 



Printed at Printrade, New Delhi, India
